title: cse-coach progress contract
description: The honest-progress data contract emitted by scripts/gamify.py and consumed by the progressiveoverflow.com dashboard. Any repo following the cse-coach schema can emit this file to be renderable. Curated + non-sensitive: aggregate stats, per-problem status and comfort timeline, and derived badges — never solution code or stuck-log prose. schemaVersion is bumped on any breaking change so a viewer can refuse an incompatible file. gamify.py ALSO emits progress-summary.json alongside this file — see $defs/summary below: same contract minus `problems[]`, with a compact `trophyCase`. The dashboard landing fetches the summary only; the full file (this schema) is fetched on explicit opt-in.

pipeline.description: Counts along the maturation ladder 🔴 blank -> 🟡 shaky -> 🟢 clean (by streak) -> 🎓 graduated -> 🏆 retired.

streak.description: SR-honest study-day streak: rewards practicing when due, with a rest-day allowance, never raw daily grind.

coverage.description: Technique breadth, from technique_coverage.md. null when that file was unreadable.

onSchedule.description: SR adherence gauge derived from each row's Next Review Date vs today.

badges.description: Derived achievements. Every trigger keys off a genuine, unfakeable event (a graduation, a retirement, a comeback, a study-day streak) — never a raw count of easy greens and never a rating.

techniques.description: Per-technique row from technique_coverage.md's Coverage table — the drill-through detail behind the technique-breadth header. Small (~56 rows); present in BOTH progress.json and progress-summary.json so the technique panel renders instantly with no extra fetch.

studyDays.description: Sorted distinct ISO dates the learner practiced — the list form behind streak.studyDays (a count). Backs the streak calendar drill. In progress.json (this schema) this is the COMPLETE lifetime list. In progress-summary.json it is a ROLLING WINDOW (the last ~26 weeks / SUMMARY_STUDY_DAYS_WINDOW days, gamify.py's summary_of()) — enough for the calendar, capped so the summary can't grow forever. The lifetime COUNT is unaffected: read streak.studyDays / streak.longest for that, never the length of this array in the summary.

warnings.description: Fail-soft notes about inputs that could not be fully read; a partial file is still valid.

summary.description: The shape of progress-summary.json: this contract minus `problems[]`, with a compact `trophyCase` (graduated entries reduced to {lcNumber, title, difficulty} — no timeline/repDates; retired entries unchanged). Written by the same gamify.py run via summary_of().

technique.description: One row of technique_coverage.md's Coverage table.

problems.description: LC numbers inside the table cell's parenthetical; excludes *+Nv* variant-rep annotations.

thin.description: Fewer than the 3-4 surface forms the technique needs.

hasVariantGap.description: A declared method variant has never once been exercised.

level.description: Comfort as an ordinal 0-4 for plotting.

timeline.description: Per-rep comfort earned, reconstructed from the weekly schedules. comfort is null where a rep predates the schedule archive — an activity dot, never a fabricated value.
